review.images: Extracted eight project-specific Aldar renders from the launch brochure. The local derivatives use WebP at up to 2,560 px on the longest edge. Unedited image masters and the 390 MB original remain in the evidence cache. Removed lifestyle stock and Cultural District render from the selection.
review.location: Aldar’s page identifies the Marina District and NYU. Aldar’s launch release identifies access to E12. Physical brochure page 36 is the labelled level-one site floorplate. Madena provides the driving estimates. Its separate overlay on a Cultural District render conflicts with the Marina District setting, so that illustration and the third-party marker were excluded.
review.floorPlans: Visually checked all 25 pages of the public Madena-hosted Aldar plan set and matched pages 15–23 to the eleven unit examples on physical brochure pages 27–35. The public plan set prints per-layout areas that are absent in the large marketing brochure. Both Type 2 and Type 4 print 143 m² under separately labelled drawings. Full original plan set is preserved.

unavailable: Verified street entrance or surveyed map pin. Signed unit-area measurement basis.
